correctness.rationale: The complete explicit graph is 120-automorphism edge-transitive. Each exhaustive finite discrete-Morse matching has its whole Hasse graph topologically sorted; exact signed Morse matrices have maximal determinant certificates −3,1,−1 with full matrix F3 rank deficit one. This proves the integral homotopy types through wedge-cell degree theory. The deletion cofibration forces a rank-six injective connecting map with saturated index exactly three. All requirements are checked by the self-contained program and actual successful output.

value.rationale: An unusually symmetric canonical planar graph has a known degree-three torsion obstruction. Proving all 30 single-edge deletions remove that obstruction and tracing the effect to a rank-six map with saturation index three offers a concrete structural explanation of torsion creation by one graph edge, beyond recomputation of Betti numbers and unlike previously established torsion-free edge-deletion splittings.
